hni_signals: PREMIUM SUB-SPECIALTY, HIGHEST-CAPEX IN CARDIOLOGY: cardiac electrophysiology - EP study and radiofrequency ablation (both epicardial and endocardial), device implantation (pacemaker, ICD, CRT) and troubleshooting, and left ventricular assist devices. Complex VT ablation and device therapy are the highest-value procedures in Indian private cardiology. SENIOR MEMBER OF A NATIONALLY LEADING EP GROUP: he is part of the AIG Institute of Cardiac Sciences and Research electrophysiology unit alongside Dr. Calambur Narasimhan and Dr. Daljeet K. Saggu, and is named as a co-author with both - AIG runs one of India's largest cardiac EP practices. SUBSTANTIAL INTERNATIONAL RESEARCH FOOTPRINT, evidenced on independent academic platforms: co-author on 'Impact of the inflammation on the outcomes of catheter ablation of drug-refractory ventricular tachycardia in cardiac sarcoidosis' (Journal of Cardiovascular Electrophysiology, Wiley, 2020); 'Atrial Fibrillation in Heart Failure: Strategies for Restoring Sinus Rhythm' (SAGE, 2024, from AIG Institute of Cardiac Sciences and Research); 'Atrial arrhythmias with mediastinal lymphadenopathy presentation of isolated atrial myocarditis' (indexed on NIH PubMed Central, from the Department of Electrophysiology, AIG Institute of Cardiac Sciences and Research); plus published work in the Indian Pacing and Electrophysiology Journal, HeartRhythm Case Reports and the Indian Heart Journal on tailored management of VT in cardiac sarcoidosis, total epicardial biventricular pacing and defibrillation, renal sympathetic denervation for resistant hypertension, LV systolic dysfunction after permanent pacemaker implantation, and induction of idiopathic fascicular VT. POPULATION-SCALE RESEARCH LEADERSHIP: contributor to the AP-AF study on the prevalence, clinical profile and stroke risk of atrial fibrillation in rural Andhra Pradesh. DUAL PAEDIATRIC-ADULT ARRHYTHMIA PRACTICE (MD Paediatrics plus DM Cardiology) - a rare and referral-generating combination. No ownership, directorship, HOD title, society office or published procedure volume surfaced publicly, so none is asserted.

notes:
Identity verified on four criteria - name ('Sachin Yalagudri' / 'Sachin D. Yalagudri', a highly distinctive surname with no competing clinician anywhere in results), sub-specialty (cardiac electrophysiology), institution (AIG) and city (Hyderabad/Gachibowli). The strongest single piece of evidence is INDEPENDENT and ACADEMIC: peer-reviewed work indexed on NIH PubMed Central carrying the byline affiliation 'Department of Electrophysiology, AIG Institute of Cardiac Sciences and Research' (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11730979/), reinforced by a 2024 SAGE paper whose author list is 'Auras R. Atreya, Sonali Arora, Muthiah Subramanian, Sachin D. Yalagudri, Calambur Narasimhan, Daljeet K. Saggu' - i.e. he publishes as part of the same AIG EP group as Dr. C. Narasimhan and Dr. Daljeet Kaur Saggu, which is exactly the affiliation the source row asserts. Practo, Credihealth, Skedoc, Sehat, DocIndia and Lybrate all independently place him as Consultant Cardiologist and Electrophysiologist at AIG Hospital Gachibowli with identical qualifications (MBBS RGUHS 2001, MD Paediatrics RGUHS 2007, DM Cardiology RGUHS 2012), but per the banding contract these are CORROBORATING ONLY and were not counted.

BAND = Medium, honestly: only ONE source that qualifies as official (the NIH/PMC-indexed academic record). hospital_profile is deliberately BLANK because AIG's per-doctor page for him is DEAD - two separate allowed_domains=aighospitals.com searches both returned https://aighospitals.com/doctors/dr-sachin-yalagudri/ with the title '404 Page Not Found', and NO live page under any of AIG's four URL families surfaced. Per the rules a 404 is not a profile and no URL may be constructed, so nothing was recorded there. A healinindia.gov.in query was folded into the search and returned no government directory entry for him.

EXPERIENCE FIGURE IS UNRELIABLE - flagged for human check. Directory summaries gave both 'over 10 years' and '24 years'. Neither is confirmable; the qualification chain (2001/2007/2012) is the reliable fact and both figures are recorded as conflicting rather than one being picked.

NO email or phone recorded. AIG publishes no per-doctor email or direct line, and no published personal email or mobile surfaced. A JustDial listing for him was returned and was DELIBERATELY REJECTED AND NOT RECORDED - JustDial numbers are call-tracking proxies, not the doctor's line, per the explicit rule. The AIG switchboard/central booking numbers that appeared in search summaries were likewise not recorded as if they were his own line; the hospital-level fallback is added by the pipeline. No LinkedIn profile surfaced and none was guessed. Nothing was pattern-derived.

owns_clinic false: no personally owned clinic, practice entity, second location or personal website was found in public search.
